[USER] User expressed interest in the Korean-Style Fried Chicken recipe and requested more details on the marinade and breading process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a detailed recipe for Korean-Style Fried Chicken, including marinade ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed the marinade ingredients:  
- 2 lbs chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces  
- 1/2 cup Korean chili flakes (gochugaru)  
- 2 cloves garlic, minced  
- 1/4 cup soy sauce  
- 1/4 cup rice vinegar  
- 2 tbsp Gochujang (Korean chili paste)  
- 2 tbsp brown sugar  
- 2 tbsp vegetable oil  
- 2 tsp grated ginger  
- 1 tsp black pepper  
- 1 tsp salt  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided the breading ingredients:  
- 1 cup all-purpose flour  
- 1 cup cornstarch  
- 1 cup panko breadcrumbs  
- 1/2 cup potato starch  
- 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese (optional)  
- Vegetable oil for frying  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant detailed the instructions for marinating, preparing the breading station, double-fisting the chicken, frying the chicken, and tips for variations.  
[USER] User asked about the necessity of the breading order and if they could use an egg wash before the breading process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that the order of breading (flour, cornstarch mixture, panko breadcrumbs) is crucial for adhesion and texture.
